query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'utah-shakespeare-festival-2024-season',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Utah Shakespeare Festival 2024 Season',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic designs for The Mountain Top and Silent Sky at the Utah Shakespeare Festival.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/lBipbevCrxDldiPO.webp',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"The 2024 season at Utah Shakespeare Festival featured my continued collaboration with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for two powerful American plays: Katori Hall''s *The Mountain Top* and Lauren Gunderson''s *Silent Sky*."},{"type":"header","content":"The Productions"},{"type":"text","content":"**The Mountain Top** reimagines Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.''s final night at the Lorraine Motel in Memphis, April 3, 1968. Jo Winiarski''s scenic design created an intimate, realistic motel room setting that served as the stage for this two-character drama exploring legacy, mortality, and the human side of an American icon. The production ran in the Eileen and Allen Anes Studio Theatre, where the intimate space enhanced the play''s emotional power.\\n\\n**Silent Sky** tells the true story of astronomer Henrietta Leavitt, whose groundbreaking work at Harvard in the early 1900s changed our understanding of the universe—despite being confined to calculating data rather than using telescopes herself. The scenic design evoked both the Harvard Observatory''s computing room and the vast cosmos Leavitt studied, creating a visual metaphor for her constrained circumstances and limitless imagination."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/mNYhZyKGoFQnEreh.jpg","caption":"Silent Sky at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2024. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The production explored Henrietta Leavitt''s astronomical discoveries through evocative staging. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"header","content":"Stories of Perseverance"},{"type":"text","content":"Both productions shared thematic resonance—stories of individuals whose contributions to history were constrained by the social limitations of their time. Jo Winiarski''s scenic designs supported these narratives by creating environments that reflected both the historical reality and the transcendent aspirations of the characters."},{"type":"header","content":"About Utah Shakespeare Festival"},{"type":"text","content":"The Utah Shakespeare Festival in Cedar City is one of the nation''s premier regional theatre companies, recipient of the Tony Award for Outstanding Regional Theatre. The Festival produces eight plays each summer in rotating repertory across three theatres, combining Shakespeare''s works with classic and contemporary plays and musicals."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","label":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}]',
  90002,
  '2024-10-05',
  '2024-10-05',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
